briefs.label: Carved wooden sea turtle
briefs.imagePrompt: A hand-carved wooden sea turtle figurine with a high domed shell painted with teal patterns, standing on its four flippers, three-quarter view from the front and slightly above, the whole figurine visible with its depth clear, studio product photo on a plain light grey background, soft even lighting
briefs.videoPrompt: the wooden sea turtle figurine swims forward, its flippers paddling up and down, the camera slowly circles around it, soft studio light

briefs.label: Lighthouse island diorama
briefs.imagePrompt: A miniature diorama of a small rocky island with a white and red lighthouse, a few pine trees and a wooden jetty, centered, whole island visible, isometric view, plain dark blue background, soft light
briefs.videoPrompt: the lighthouse beam sweeps around, waves lap at the rocks of the small island, the camera slowly orbits the diorama
